scenarios.given: The same fixed subject and assets run on release-blocking Windows and Ubuntu profiles.
scenarios.expected: Contract verdict and acceptance meaning are identical despite platform-specific process/filesystem adapters.

scenarios.given: Locale, timezone, encoding, cwd, dependency, or tool identity differs from the fixed profile.
scenarios.expected: Reject or rebuild the plan; never consume the result as bound PASS.

scenarios.given: A writable candidate is on UNC/SMB/NFS or an unverified filesystem.
scenarios.expected: Return filesystem_profile_unsupported and perform no mutation.

scenarios.given: A preview platform passes its checks.
scenarios.expected: Keep preview status and do not claim release-blocking platform coverage.

scenarios.given: A normal suite has a reliable 60-second reference.
scenarios.when: The bootstrap planner fixes its deadline.
scenarios.expected: Use at least 150 seconds and do not restore a legacy 30-second deadline.

scenarios.given: No declared duration, p95, or reliable collected estimate exists.
scenarios.expected: Use the 600-second hard deadline.

scenarios.given: A normal generic command emits no stdout and exposes no trustworthy progress signal.
scenarios.when: It remains within the hard deadline.
scenarios.expected: Do not classify silence as no-progress.

scenarios.given: A trustworthy progress stream stops beyond max twice its interval or 120 seconds.
scenarios.expected: Terminate boundedly and classify no_progress_detected as incomplete infrastructure execution.

scenarios.given: Required suite estimate exceeds the remaining Work Package ceiling.
scenarios.expected: Return verification_plan_not_ready before starting a process and do not weaken the suite.

scenarios.given: A timeout occurs without new plan, environment, shard, or evidence.
scenarios.expected: Reject exact no-progress repeat; an Agent cannot extend the deadline.

scenarios.given: A process emits excessive bytes, lines, events, and repeated tracebacks.
scenarios.expected: Apply every configured bound during drain and aggregate repeat fingerprints.

scenarios.given: A timed-out command creates background descendants.
scenarios.when: Termination runs on Windows or Ubuntu.
scenarios.expected: Boundedly stop the verified process tree/group before reporting cleanup complete.

scenarios.given: A tool-created temporary root retains its matching ownership identity.
scenarios.expected: Remove only that owned root.

scenarios.given: Temporary-root identity, permission, symlink, junction, or reparse state is uncertain.
scenarios.expected: Preserve and quarantine the root; do not recursively delete it.

scenarios.given: The selected tool is degraded and a pre-approved semantically equivalent backend is available.
scenarios.expected: Select the approved fallback without changing acceptance.

scenarios.given: A required capability is unavailable and no equivalent fallback exists.
scenarios.expected: Return capability_unavailable; never PASS or silently weaken isolation.

scenarios.given: A repository-local managed asset update is proposed.
scenarios.expected: Produce isolated output, delta preview, compatibility verdict, and no target mutation.

scenarios.given: The target contains user-customized content not owned by the current manifest.
scenarios.expected: Return managed_asset_user_change_conflict and preserve user content.

scenarios.given: Preview is compatible and target identity remains current.
scenarios.expected: Post-apply parity matches the fixed manifest without remove-then-copy.

scenarios.given: The same current manifest was already applied successfully.
scenarios.expected: Produce no delta and preserve identical parity.

scenarios.given: Map facts bind repository, branch, resolved commit, worktree, Candidate, and view.
scenarios.expected: Record exact consumed facts with all identities.

scenarios.given: Branch name is unchanged but resolved commit changes.
scenarios.when: Prior Context, impact, or asset preview is considered.
scenarios.expected: Invalidate the prior binding and rebuild affected derived artifacts.

scenarios.given: A query requests another branch view.
scenarios.expected: Do not switch or modify the user's working tree.

scenarios.given: Operational telemetry reports healthy execution.
scenarios.expected: Telemetry cannot supply specification, admission, PASS, or completion authority.

scenarios.given: Many routine executions finish.
scenarios.expected: Keep bounded summaries and discard permanent raw logs and redundant receipts.

scenarios.given: This Phase 5 specification validator passes.
scenarios.expected: Claim package integrity only; leave work package, subsystem, domain, release, deployment, and release not evaluated.
